lines: I leapt onto the train's door
When I looked back, he'd hidden himself
Dyes even my tears as I run
I knew of the promise to meet someone older
A shadow fell across my heart
The knot of love coming undone
I want to meet him and ask him
Please give him back to me
But no, I'm too timid — even my lips freeze
That we've run out of things to say
Is proof you've grown tired of me
Among the colors of the turning seasons,
The dictionary I borrowed — I'll return it tomorrow
Where the word "love" was cut out
That I'm the only one who gets hurt
Is the kindness you've left me
The tricolor dress for the seaside —
